name: GoldBull / CoinLure — Group-IB
brief: Group-IB identified two AI-fraud campaigns: GoldBull runs pump-and-dump schemes on real stocks using deepfake video ads impersonating a generic "financial professional"/"head analyst" persona to drive victims into coordinated WhatsApp groups; CoinLure industrialized fake crypto-investment platforms (208 domains, 23 shared templates, ~$187M estimated revenue) funneling victims through fake registration/KYC/trial-fund traps. Group-IB
